text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In preparation for the decisive February 
Stakes, she carried out all kinds of 
fortune-boosting rituals, such as bathing 
toward lucky directions and drinking 
drinks in her lucky colors.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having regained her faith in feng shui, 
Copano Rickey clashes head-on with Hokko 
Tarumae, each carrying the hopes of their 
hometowns.
